info.title: Meerkat Admin API
info.description: Meerkat's control plane, on the admin port. Try it out uses your console session, or send a control-plane API token (`Authorization: Bearer mk_...`, created under Access tokens). Every change applies at once and is recorded in the audit trail.

adminToken.description: A control-plane API token (`mk_...`). Personal API tokens are refused here.

Unauthorized.description: Not signed in, or the sign-in is not complete

Invalid.description: Refused, with a message naming what is wrong

type.description: Predicate or filter type, as `/api/catalog` lists it.

args.description: Parameters by name. Unknown names are refused.

level.description: Empty: no check. `auth`: signed in. `tenant`: with an active tenant. `tenants`: an active tenant among `tenants`. `deny`: only the named users.

roles.description: Role names; the caller needs one of them in the active tenant, besides the level.

Access.description: Level and roles must both be met; named users always pass. Empty: no check.

per.description: Counted per route (default), user, API token, tenant or client address.

applies.description: Only these callers, as in an access rule. Empty: everybody.

RateLimit.description: A traffic limit. All apply; the first exceeded refuses the request.

method.description: Upper-case HTTP method, or `*` for any.

path.description: OpenAPI path with `{var}`, route prefix included.

level.description: Empty: no check. `auth`: signed in. `tenant`: with an active tenant. `tenants`: an active tenant among `tenants`. `deny`: only the named users.

roles.description: Role names; the caller needs one of them in the active tenant, besides the level.

inherit.description: No rule of its own: the route's applies (for rate limits only).

limits.description: Rate limits on this operation, on top of the route's.

EndpointPolicy.description: One operation's access rule (the `Access` fields). The first match wins.

endpoints.description: Per-operation rules. The first match wins.

EndpointSecurity.description: Access rules on the operations of the route's OpenAPI spec.

from.description: Path variable, query parameter, header, or JSON pointer into the body.

key.description: Variable, parameter or header name, or JSON pointer (`/order/id`).

description.description: What the call means in the audit trail; defaults to the OpenAPI summary.

body.description: Record the request body (JSON, 64 KiB at most), masked fields replaced.

mask.description: Fields never recorded in clear, at any depth, case-insensitive. Empty: password, passwd, secret, token, apiKey, api_key, authorization, cookie.

EndpointAudit.description: An audited operation: each call is recorded.

type.description: `upstream`: fetched from the service on each read. `file`: an uploaded copy served by Meerkat.

path.description: upstream: path on the upstream, or an absolute URL. file: segment served under the route's prefix, ending in `.json` (default `openapi.json`).

RouteSpecSource.description: Where a route's OpenAPI spec comes from.

audit.description: Audited operations. Enterprise edition: refused in the Community edition.

roleMap.description: Each role the spec declares (e.g. ROLE_ADMIN) to the role that grants it here.

RouteAPI.description: The route's OpenAPI spec and its operation rules.

select.description: Offer the light/dark switch in the account button.

mechanism.description: Empty: CSS color-scheme only. `none`: no scheme. `attribute`: an attribute set to light or dark. `add-attribute`, `class`: an attribute or class added. `script`: calls `script`.

light.description: Value, attribute name or class for light.

dark.description: Value, attribute name or class for dark.

button.description: Account button scheme when `select` is off: follow the visitor, light or dark.

storageOverride.description: Rewrite the application's own localStorage entry.

storage.description: localStorage key of the application's choice.

storageAuto.description: Value for follow-the-system; empty removes the entry.

noAuto.description: The application knows only light and dark: auto is resolved first.

script.description: Body of function(colorScheme), called with light, dark or auto. 4000 characters at most.

SchemeConfig.description: How the application receives the colour scheme.

mechanism.description: Classes (default), an attribute, or a meta tag.

attribute.description: Attribute or meta name (default data-roles / meerkat-roles).

RolesConfig.description: Puts the user's role names on the page, for CSS.

mechanism.description: Attributes on a tag (default) or meta tags.

fields.description: Field to attribute or meta name (empty: the field name). Fields: username, userid, fullname, email, tenant, tenantid, timezone, locale, or a custom field.

UserInfoConfig.description: Puts facts about the signed-in user on the page.

position.description: Anchor corner, default top-right. The menu opens away from the first word's edge.

name.description: Where the username shows; empty hides it.

inFrame.description: Show it inside a frame too.

UserButton.description: The account button added to the page.

code.description: The code, 64 KiB at most. Empty with `file`.

file.description: A file uploaded on the route, linked instead of pasted.

position.description: Place in the page; default head-end.

load.description: classic (empty), defer, async or module. defer and async: files only.

injections.description: Added in this order at each place.

RouteUI.description: UI options (`isUi`): colour scheme, roles and user facts, account button, custom code.

field.description: username, userid, fullname, tenant, tenantid, email, timezone, locale, roles, or a custom field (`/api/model`).

as.description: Header or claim name; default the field name.

asJson.description: roles only: a JSON array, not a comma-separated string.

expr.description: roles only: a pipeline shaping the list, e.g. {{.Roles | .Keep "tag:BILLING" | cut "ROLE_" | join ","}}. Empty: the plain list.

mechanism.description: headers: one per attribute. jwt, signed-jwt: a bearer token. oidc: the application signs users in with Meerkat (Enterprise edition). Empty: nothing sent.

ttl.description: jwt, signed-jwt: token lifetime, ISO 8601; default 2 minutes.

audience.description: jwt, signed-jwt: `aud`; default the route name.

mechanism.description: How the language is sent besides Accept-Language: a header, a query parameter, a path segment, or a page script.

mechanisms.description: Deprecated: the first value is read, removed on next save.

onChange.description: script: JavaScript run with `locale` on load and each change; must not reload the page.

LocalesConfig.description: Languages the route offers and how the choice is sent.

connect.description: Connection limit (TLS included), ISO 8601, 1 s to 30 s. Empty: installation default (5 s).

response.description: Limit for response headers, ISO 8601, 1 s to 10 min. Empty: installation default (15 s). No body limit.

trip.description: Consecutive failures that open it, 2 to 100 (default 5).

cool.description: Open time before a test request, ISO 8601, 1 s to 5 min (default 15 s).

CircuitBreaker.description: Stops calling an upstream that fails. Off unless enabled.

id.description: Taken from the path on a save.

rev.description: Revision read. Send it back on save: 409 if changed since; 0 or absent overwrites.

order.description: Evaluation order, lowest first; first match wins.

access.description: Rule for the whole route. A refused caller falls through to the next matching route.

isUi.description: Turns on UI options (account button, injections, languages in the path).

telemetry.description: Report telemetry on this route (default true). Caller trace headers are forwarded either way.

telemetryUi.description: Add the OpenTelemetry browser script to the pages. UI routes only.

upstream.description: Target base URL; may hold `$name` vault references. Unused with a terminal filter.

predicates.description: All must match. At least one.

problem.description: Read-only: why this saved route is not served; absent when it is.

initial.description: Value the console pre-fills. Never applied by the server.

literal.description: Taken as is: `$name` vault references are not resolved.

upstream.description: What the spec says the application requires; for information only.

prefix.description: Route path part included in every operation path.

declaredRoles.description: Roles the spec declares, in the application's names.

url.description: Where it is served on the data plane.

shadows.description: Status the upstream answers at that address, when the file hides something there.

jwksPath.description: JWKS path on the internal plane.

internalOrigin.description: Internal plane address on the platform; absent if unknown.

issuers.description: Possible values: the data plane's public addresses.

publicDiscovery.description: OpenID discovery document under the issuer; absent if not served.

SigningKeys.description: Public keys signing the identity sent upstream, and where they are published.

at.description: Time for time predicates; default now.

lottery.description: Random draw in [0,1) for weight predicates (default 0.5).

notes.description: Responses only: what could not be simulated.

ProbeRequestShape.description: A request as routing sees it.

rule.description: The access rule lets the caller through (when predicates matched).

steps.description: Each active route's result, in order.

winnerId.description: Route that took the request; absent for a 404.

target.description: The service is up; absent if unknown or the route answers itself.

source.description: Platform that answered; empty if none.

name.description: Full service name, unique in the cluster.

names.description: Names resolving to it in the network, best first.

counted.description: ready and wanted are real counts.

reachable.description: False when the service shares no network with this gateway.

unavailable.description: Why no platform answered, and how to fix it.

namespaces.description: Kubernetes: namespaces this gateway may list.

byClass.description: Requests by status class: index n is nxx (1 to 5); 0 unused.

buckets.description: Latency counts per boundary of `buckets`, plus one beyond the last.

failures.description: Upstream failures: unreachable, timeout, open circuit, 502/503/504.

excluded.description: Excluded from OpenTelemetry; still counted here.

RouteTraffic.description: One route's traffic over one interval.

endpoints.description: With `endpoints`: per-operation figures of the answering gateway.

Topics: `changes`, `presence`, `certificates`, `door-traffic`, `pause`, `traffic` (200 samples at most), `route-health`, `logs`, `schedules`; a counter topic means re-read its REST API.
